_comment: The fixed evaluation box set. `expect`: 'solved' = this agent has demonstrably solved it end-to-end at least once, so it must stay solvable (a drop is a regression); 'unknown' = not yet solved, scored for information only. `crux`: the decisive skill/step, for reading where a run died. Add a box by appending a row AND recording one real run under runs/<name>/. Seeded 2026-10-18 from the existing runs.

boxes.name: Nimbus
boxes.crux: SQS SendMessage: SigV4 signing + exact queue-name/URL format — a mechanical request-shaping step, not a vector choice
